scope: One PC: real WebGL public join UI, failed endpoint, retry, native host loss, local-play recovery and canceled pending join; no physical Wi-Fi/device claim.

checks.name: Failed public invitation restores setup and visible Join Game without Escape
Public failure uses player copy while transport detail remains in debug log
Retry through the same player UI/NetworkManager reaches real native authority
Unexpected native host loss restores actionable Join Game
Local play and a real launch work after host loss
Pending join has a visible Cancel Joining action and restores setup
Intentional cancellation does not trigger a spurious failure reopen
Canceled player retries through normal Join UI and reaches native authority
Connected public Disconnect restores local setup without a failure reopen
